name: two-hole flat plate
description: A flat rectangular plate laid flat on the XY plane with its thickness in Z, centred on the origin in X and Y. All four vertical corner edges are rounded. Two mounting holes pass all the way through, on the long centreline, one either side of centre.
notes: Hole centres are at x = -1.000 and x = +1.000, both at y = 0. Round only the four VERTICAL corner edges, not the top and bottom faces.
